gpt-5.4-nano.notes: Standard direct API pricing. Cached input is not separately persisted by the current ADK trace, so historical estimates conservatively price all prompt tokens at the standard input rate.

pexels.notes: Pexels states that API content is available free of charge; request quotas still apply.

wikimedia_commons.notes: The pipeline uses Wikimedia's public community API, which has no per-request billing. Wikimedia Enterprise is a separate high-volume commercial product and is not used here.

generated_fallback.notes: Fallback cards are generated locally with Pillow and incur no external provider charge.

github_actions_standard_public_runner.notes: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories. Larger runners are excluded from this assumption.

github_actions_artifact_storage.notes: Only usage above the account's included/shared artifact allowance is billable. The Review Hub cannot see account-level billing utilization, so storage exposure is reported separately and excluded from the episode total.
